messages.content: You're a musician with a fine-looking lute.
I'll give you this for your lute. [OFFER: rusty_pipe]

You want me to trade my music for a piece of plumbing? I think I'll pass.
{"give":[],"take":[]}
Come on, this pipe is high-quality copper. It's worth something.

It's worth more as a pipe than as an instrument. My lute has a story. That pipe has rust. The answer is no.
